title: CaRDS: Compiler-aided Remote Data Structures
problem: Conservative compile-time policies for far memory placement harm performance when memory is constrained
motivation: Applications need dynamic far memory policies that adapt to runtime conditions without expensive profiling
method: Compiler-runtime hybrid: static analysis identifies candidate objects, runtime determines remoting/prefetch/evacuation policies at data structure granularity
key_novelty: Dynamic far memory policies at data structure granularity combining compile-time static analysis with runtime adaptation
contributions: CaRDS system for dynamic far memory management
25% of profile-guided performance without profiling overhead
